purpose: Frozen, hashable weight-sensitivity grid for Pari English Core close-contender analysis. Predeclared BEFORE any robustness results are observed so no weight vector can be chosen after one model loses. Changing this file changes its recorded SHA-256 and invalidates any robustness plan that pinned the old hash.
normalization: Each vector is expressed in integer percent and must sum to exactly 100. Composite100 = sum over dimensions of (dimensionScore100 * weight/100).

product.source: english-core-config.json composite.weights (Pari product prior, not a literature constant)

paraphrase_first.rationale: If the product's job is paraphrasing, semantics and collocation should dominate more than general grammar/fluency.

fluency_first.rationale: If the product's job is polished reader-facing prose, register/fluency/generation should dominate.

structure_first.rationale: If the product's job is grammatical control over a discourse arc, grammar/lexical/discourse should dominate.

leaveOneOut.derivation: For each dimension d, set weight[d]=0 and renormalize the remaining six weights so they sum back to 100. This is the leave-one-dimension-style check; it detects whether one dimension alone drives the product-weighted lead.
leaveOneOut.note: Leave-one-out vectors are derived deterministically from the frozen product vector, not hand-edited, so they cannot drift from the base weighting.

seeds.note: Matches the paired-bootstrap seed convention already used by compare-english-core-models.mjs so the weight grid does not introduce a second, incompatible randomness convention.

stoppingRules: Compute every vector in this grid; never add, drop or reweight a vector after seeing contender results.
A ranking that changes across the frozen grid is reported as weight-dependent ordering, not as a winner.
A comparison whose paired bootstrap interval contains zero is reported as inconclusive, never as a forced winner.
If a candidate is missing any scored item required for paired comparison, the paired headline for that pair is withheld rather than computed on partial overlap.
